rules.title: Just Cause Required for Termination of Tenancy (San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7)
rules.requirement: Landlords must give tenants notice of protections, and for at-fault terminations give notice and opportunity to cure. For no-fault terminations they must give written notice stating the basis, pay relocation assistance (direct payment or rent waiver), and offer to re-lease within five years. Landlords must notify the Commission, and failure to comply voids the termination notice. Buyout agreements are regulated and cannot be for less than the relocation assistance.
rules.key_value: Relocation assistance of 2 months' rent (3 months if tenant is senior or disabled) for no-fault terminations
rules.penalty: Termination notice void; damages of not less than three times actual economic damages for wrongful eviction; not less than three times required relocation assistance plus actual damages; punitive damages; attorney's fees and costs in court's discretion; City enforcement with civil and criminal remedies.
rules.status_basis: Added 5-25-2023 by O-21647 N.S.; effective 6-24-2023; amended 2-27-2024 by O-21769 N.S., effective 3-28-2024.
